prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1223; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is for claim purposes only. Do you understand and agree to be recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on Broadway in Pearland, Texas, heading east toward the intersection near the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me.

Q: What happened next?

A: I came to a stop behind a car at the light. About a few seconds later, I felt a hard impact from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: I got out briefly to check on my car, but I didn't feel steady. My neck and right shoulder were really sore, so I sat back down until the police arrived.

Q: Did you speak with the other driver?

A: Yes. He said he was looking at his phone and didn't see that I had stopped. He seemed apologetic.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They took X-rays and told me I had a strained shoulder and possible soft tissue damage. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. Lifting anything overhead is hard, and I'm having trouble sleeping on my right side. My doctor said recovery could take several more weeks.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered everything. I just want my car repaired and my medical bills taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
